title: Message boards, ii
logline: Wood argues with the internet at 2 AM. The internet is a stick figure that never sleeps.

panels.composition: The garage at 2 AM. Monitor glow. WOOD typing hard. One stick figure at the back, awake, typing back on a stick-figure keyboard.

balloons.text: The Sundays are not 'the only good part.' The Sundays are the part that doesn't have to be funny. The dailies are the work.

image.prompt: a young man typing furiously at a glowing monitor at 2 AM in a dark garage while a single stick figure at the back of the panel types back on its own tiny keyboard, a dog asleep, neon monitor glow cutting the dark

panels.composition: The stick figure's reply, drawn as its balloon: 'ok but the dog one from tuesday was funnier than anything in the novel page and you know it'

balloons.text: ok but the dog one from tuesday was funnier than anything in the novel page and you know it

image.prompt: close-up of a stick figure with a long deadpan speech balloon, monitor glow

panels.composition: Wood, hands off the keyboard. Looking at the dog. The dog asleep, one leg twitching.

characters.pose: hands off the keys, looking at the dog

image.prompt: a young man with his hands lifted off a keyboard looking down at a sleeping dog whose leg twitches, monitor glow, no words

panels.composition: Wood back at the keyboard. Typing one word. The stick figure reading it. We don't see it. 2:41.

image.prompt: a young man typing a single word at 2:41 AM while a stick figure leans in to read it, the screen turned away from the viewer, no words
image.notes: The word is not shown. The reader guesses 'yes.'

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: 2 AM. The internet is right about the dog. He types one word.
